'''Gus D'Alessio''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[October 1999 Glenside tournament]] on 24 October 1999 with Tatooine Occupation, according to Kim Caton's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d86">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-glenside-pa-10-24-99d86/ glenside-pa-10-24-99], DeckTech (Kimberly "Arwen Even*" Caton, 25 October 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-10-25-glenside-pa-10-24-99d86/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
